text.p: These were the main reports on Latvian radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Prime Minister Andris Shkele may meet Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin soon
- One of the main government parties Latvia's Way is in favour of government stability
- OSCE High Commissioner for Minorities Max van der Stoel is on a two-day visit to Latvia
- A conference of Baltic industrialists in Jurmala is discussing how to develop their markets.
- Lithuania and Iceland are to sign a visa-free regime.
